neet_phy_u04_t05_1.working: By energy conservation, v = sqrt(2gh) = sqrt(2*10*20) = 20 m/s.

neet_phy_u04_t05_2.working: Drop in height h = L(1 - cos60°) = 2.5*0.5 = 1.25 m. So v = sqrt(2*10*1.25) = 5 m/s.

neet_phy_u04_t05_3.working: Loss of potential energy = mgh = 100 J. Final kinetic energy = (1/2)(2)(64) = 64 J. Work done by friction = 64 - 100 = -36 J.

neet_phy_u04_t05_4.working: Assuming the body is released from rest at height H, total energy is mgH. KE at H/2 = mgH/2 (II). PE at H/4 = mgH/4 (I). KE at H/4 = mgH - mgH/4 = 3mgH/4 (III). Total mechanical energy = mgH (IV).

neet_phy_u04_t05_5.working: A is true: v = sqrt(2gh), independent of the path. B is false: speed does not depend on mass. C is true: friction does negative work equal to the change in mechanical energy. D is false: total energy of an isolated system is conserved. E is true: at h/2, KE = PE = mgh/2.
